Harnesses框架

11 research harnesses across 6 architecture families.11 个研究框架，覆盖 6 类架构。

Every harness runs the same frozen tasks on 2 backbone LLMs under the same sandbox search contract. Cards are ordered by the Arena score (reach^1.5 × jury win rate), averaged across backbones; the bars inside each card show the per-LLM scores.每个框架都在 2 个主干模型上运行同一批冻结任务、使用同一套沙箱搜索契约。卡片按跨模型平均的 Arena 主分（可达率^1.5 × 陪审团胜率）排序,卡片内的条形是各模型的单独得分。

Deep Research Arena

A reproducible benchmark for deep-research agents: frozen tasks, auditable reports, jury decisions, and judge-free citation checks.一项可复现的深度研究智能体基准：冻结任务、可审计报告、陪审团裁决与不依赖判官的引用核验。
